notes: EXPORTED CONTRACT (desk/src/tv/keys.ts). keyOf(k: string): Key | null, where Key = 'up'|'down'|'left'|'right'|'select'|'back'|'menu'|'play'. tvKey(s: Session, key: Key, local: Local = LOCAL): Step. It is pure. Local = {busy, table, hintInFlight}. Step = {events: Event[] (to post in order), calls: Call[] (fired after the events), local: Partial<Local> (applied at once)}. Call = {url, body, onFail?: Partial<Local>, onDone?: Partial<Local>}. runStep(step, {post, call, apply}) applies step.local first, so a second press already sees it. It then awaits each post in order and fires the calls. A non-ok answer or a thrown call applies onFail; an ok answer applies onDone. If an event fails to post, every call's onFail is applied and the calls are skipped. page.tsx keeps Local in a ref (read by the key handler) plus a state (for rendering). It still clears busy when the screen leaves 'topics'. Current contracts: the practice call on Topics sets onFail {busy:false}; /api/hint (page Select, and hint 'stuck' at stage 1) sets onFail and onDone {hintInFlight:false} and is skipped while hintInFlight is true. FOR desk-pipelines A: tvKey receives the whole Session, so a handler can read s.jobs directly. Hint 502 and 409 answers are already non-ok and already clear hintInFlight through onFail. If a job should keep the guard up until s.jobs settles, drop onDone from the hint call and clear the flag from an effect on s.jobs, or add a Local field. FOR tv-surface B: the handlers live in a table, KEYMAP: Partial<Record<Screen, Handler>> with Handler = (s, k, local, o: Out) => void. Fold sheetKey in by adding KEYMAP.sheet and rewriting KEYMAP.walk and KEYMAP.practice (today practice Back posts practice.clear and then nav topics; walk Back posts practice.clear). Out's helpers are ev, nav(screen, focus=0, from?), focus, move(n, delta), grid(k, n, cols) and hint. The Topics set request is written inline in KEYMAP.topics; 'Six more' can copy it or factor it out. continueCard is in desk/src/tv/mathsRows.ts. Its target type is ContinueGo = Extract<Screen, 'practice'|'walk'|'page'>. Once 'sheet' is in Screen, add it to that Extract and add the card branch. KEYMAP.tonight already does o.nav(cont.go) for any go other than 'page', so no key code changes. Stop lists (drawn by screens.tsx through stopAt(list, focus), which clamps to the last stop): LANDING_STOPS, tonightStops(s), learnerStops(s), unitStops(s), calendarStops(), LENS_STOPS (= ESSAY_TYPES), PLAYBOOK_STOPS, HINT_STOPS, SENTENCE_STOPS, RECAP_STOPS, TOPIC_STOPS (= SYLLABUS), walkStops(s). The profile screen still uses profileRows. A sheetStops list belongs in the same pattern. lingaOwns(s) is the single Linga predicate; tvKey returns an empty step under it, and the Linga screens' keys are untouched. The wave-1 EngineError prefix touches no TV text here: the TV never renders a call's error body, only the bench status line that the routes dispatch. Nothing under desk/src/english/* was edited.
